requirements.summary: Make the static file frontend/public/app-ads.txt publicly accessible at /app-ads.txt without modifying any other files
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to https://tetrisverse-5h9.caffeine.xyz/app-ads.txt returns the raw app-ads.txt content (the AdMob publisher line).
No other frontend components, pages, or styles are changed.

file_operations.description: Verify that the existing app-ads.txt file contains the correct Google AdMob publisher verification entry for TetrisVerse and is properly formatted as a plain text file. The file should already exist at this location and will be automatically served by the development server and build system at the /app-ads.txt route due to the public directory conventions of Vite (the build tool used by this React project). No code changes are required—this operation confirms the file is in place and correctly formatted.
